summary: Registration intake is not ready for delivery. Resolved since the last attempt: `.env.local` now contains `NEXTAUTH_URL`, `NEXTAUTH_SECRET`, Google OAuth variables, GitHub OAuth variables, and `DATABASE_URL`. Remaining blockers: Prisma is still not initialized for application use (`Test-Path prisma` returned `False`; no `prisma/schema.prisma`; `npm ls next-auth @auth/core @auth/prisma-adapter @prisma/client prisma --depth=0` showed only `prisma@8.0.0-rc.14`); no auth dependency or provider wiring exists; and `.ai_factory/delivery/planning` is missing. Evidence commands run: `Get-Content package.json`, `Get-Content prisma.config.ts`, `rg -n "next-auth|NextAuth|authjs|@auth|OAuth|Google|GitHub|Github|register|registration|PrismaClient|datasource db|generator client|model User|model Account|model Customer|model Session|DATABASE_URL|NEXTAUTH_SECRET|AUTH_SECRET|NEXTAUTH_URL" .ai_factory src package.json prisma.config.ts next.config.ts playwright.config.ts tsconfig.json .env.local`, `npm ls next-auth @auth/core @auth/prisma-adapter @prisma/client prisma --depth=0`, and `Get-ChildItem -Force .ai_factory\delivery\planning`, which failed because the path does not exist. No tests were run for this readiness review.

defects.description: The intake requires Google/GitHub registration, but the repository has no auth dependency or implementation. Evidence: `package.json` dependencies contain only Next/React; `npm ls next-auth @auth/core @auth/prisma-adapter @prisma/client prisma --depth=0` showed only `prisma@8.0.0-rc.14`; targeted `rg` found env names and prior review artifacts but no NextAuth/Auth.js provider wiring, callback route, registration UI, or session integration.

The human decision requests Prisma-backed customer records, but Prisma is not initialized for application use. Evidence: `Test-Path prisma` returned `False`; there is no `prisma/schema.prisma`; `prisma.config.ts` only configures Prisma skills agents; package inspection found no `@prisma/client`; targeted search found no `datasource db`, `generator client`, `PrismaClient`, or `User`/`Account`/`Customer`/`Session` models.

The intake states only that customers can register using Google and GitHub. Required delivery decisions remain undocumented: selected auth library/version, callback routes, post-registration redirect, persisted customer fields, duplicate account-linking behavior, and admin/customer visibility expectations. Evidence: `.ai_factory/docs/project-brief.md` leaves module constraints and acceptance expectations unspecified; `Get-ChildItem -Force .ai_factory\delivery\planning` failed with `Cannot find path 'C:\workspace\AI\ai_factory_projects\customer-feedback-portal\.ai_factory\delivery\planning' because it does not exist.`
